TITLE: Paid Work Order – Lead Technician Shows as Plain Text, Not a Disabled Field
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10047 · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: PROBABLY NOT A DEFECT — PRD §4 (lead cannot be changed once Invoiced or Paid) is met; only the look differs from the developer note / QA handoff ("the lead select is disabled").

h2. Description

On a *Paid* work order, *the Lead Technician select on the status card should be shown disabled* (QA handoff §7).

For example,
* the status card shows *Lead technician* as plain read-only text, with no greyed-out field
* clicking it opens nothing, and the lead cannot be changed (this part is correct)

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open a *Paid* work order (e.g. S10043-18248).
# Look at *Lead technician* on the status card at the left.
#* It is plain text, not a greyed-out (disabled) field.
# Click it.
#* Nothing opens; the lead does not change.

*Actual Result:*
* Lead technician shows as plain text on a Paid work order (it cannot be changed).

*Expected Result:*
* The Lead Technician field is shown disabled (greyed out) and cannot be changed.
